findings.question: indicator C1: Does the state operate its own government data centres that are in operation today?

findings.question: indicator C2: Is a national sovereign or government cloud platform in operation (not announced)?
findings.quote: Eind 2026 verwachten wij oplevering van de proof of concept en in 2027 de eerste migraties van applicaties zodat verdere opschaling in periode 2028-2030 haalbaar wordt.

findings.title: Notitie Verkenning Overheidsbrede Soevereine Clouddiensten
findings.note: The sovereign government cloud is still a proof of concept, so the printed 'Yes' is not supported; the cited letter itself says first applications can be hosted 'uiterlijk eind 2026'. The existing ODCs offer only 'cloudachtige diensten' (cloud-like services).

review.reason: In context, the NDS Cloud programme's new sovereign cloud service is still being built: the proof of concept is expected at the end of 2026 and the first migrations in 2027, so it is not in operation.

findings.question: indicator L3: Is a cloud certification that requires immunity from non-EU law in force or adopted for government use?

findings.quote_english: The definition of a sovereign cloud service implies various requirements and criteria for judging whether a cloud service is sovereign. These requirements are at present not yet set in legislation.
findings.title: Notitie Verkenning Overheidsbrede Soevereine Clouddiensten
